name: dev.ucp.shopping.declared_fields
title: Declared Fields Extension
description: Negotiates response-advertised JSON Schema contracts for reverse-domain-namespaced data bags attached to UCP shopping entities. Each schema in the response capability config validates the declared_fields value under the same reverse-domain key.

response_config.title: Declared Fields Response Config
response_config.description: Complete set of declared field family schemas. Each reverse-domain key maps directly to the JSON Schema for the object under the same key in declared_fields.

additionalProperties.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 object schema for one reverse-domain-namespaced declared field family. The schema is advertised by the Business and validates the object carried under the same key in declared_fields.

declared_fields.title: Declared Fields
declared_fields.description: Reverse-domain-namespaced declared data bags. Each key must have a matching schema in the active Declared Fields response config, and each object value is validated by that schema.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Declared Fields
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout extended with reverse-domain-namespaced declared data bags.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with Declared Fields
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with reverse-domain-namespaced declared data bags.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Declared Fields
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with read-only reverse-domain-namespaced declared data bags.

response_schema.title: Declared Fields Capability (Response)
response_schema.description: Response declaration containing the active JSON Schema overlay bag.
